profile.products: Transformers are a small line inside a cable-led group. Bahra-TBS plant: oil-immersed distribution transformers (BOIT) up to 36 kV, 50–2,500 kVA and >2,500–5,000 kVA, ONAN, Cu/Al windings, oval cores; "production capacity to produce 3,500 units/year"; SEC-spec (51-SDMS) three-phase pad-mounted and pole-mounted units, unit substations 300–1,500 kVA (56-SDMS), KNAN ester units, package substations (RMU bought from SEC-approved makers). Cast-resin dry-type 100–5,000 kVA up to 36 kV (Legrand-licensed design, CESI type-tested). Also busways, LV panels, and (main business) LV/MV/HV cables, building wires, OPGW, wiring devices, cable trays, Al/Cu rods.
